title: Upper Bounds on the Turán Density of Hypergraphs Associated with the Projective Plane over a Finite Field
summary: Let $\PG(2,q)$ denote the projective plane over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$ where $q\geq2$ is a prime power. For a positive integer $t$, let $B_{t}[\PG(2,q)]$ denote the $t$-page book obtained from $t-$many copies of the $(q+1)-$graph $\PG(2,q)$, sharing a common edge. Employing the $\mathsf{L}^p-$method and using the incidence structure of the projective plane, we establish that the upper bound of Turán density of $B_{t}[\PG(2,q)]$ is $(q(q+1)^{-1})^{\frac{1}{qt}}$.
